title: Kind
description: Contact information for an individual or entity

_oldDocs.definition: This property specifies the address of the contact
The email address of the contact.
_oldDocs.usageNote: Use email with function name instead of individual name (e.g. support). The email address should be formatted as url starting with "mailto:" scheme

family-name.title: family name
family-name.description: The family name of the contact

_oldDocs.definition: This property specifies the family name of the person to contact

fn.title: formatted name
fn.description: The formatted text of the name of the contact

_oldDocs.definition: The formatted text corresponding to the name of the contact

given-name.title: given name
given-name.description: The given name of the contact

_oldDocs.definition: This property specifies the given name of the person to contact

organization-name.title: organization name
organization-name.description: The name of the organization to contact

_oldDocs.definition: This property specifies the name of the organization to contact

tel.title: telephone
tel.description: The telephone number for the contact

_oldDocs.definition: This property specifies the telephone number for telephony communication with the person or organization.

title.title: position title
title.description: The position role of the person to contact

_oldDocs.definition: This property specifies the position role of the person to contact

_oldDocs.rationale: The introduction of vcard:Kind in DCAT-US 3.0 is driven by the need for standardized, reliable, and interoperable Point of Contact information, ultimately improving the accessibility and usability of data resources within the DCAT-US ecosystem.
